header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: Learned Additional A.G has filed parawise comments of respondent No.4, which are taken on record. Perusal of prayer clauses show that the petitioner was terminated on 15-09- 2017 and he has challenged such termination order by way of instant petition before this court; however, this Court in view of Article 212(2) of Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, has no jurisdiction to entertain this petition; therefore, same being non- maintainable is hereby dismissed alongwith listed pending application, leaving the petitioner to challenge his termination before the forum having jurisdiction. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
